record.title: Saudi restriction on Yemen-bound personal SUVs, March–April 2021
record.scope: Outbound vehicle-category restriction at the Saudi–Yemen land route
record.movement: Yemen-bound SUV owners and travellers; commercial military-use pickups separately implicated.
record.exceptions: April 25 passage required owner presence; full residual commercial and vehicle-model exclusions not reconstructed.
record.imposing_authority: Saudi border authorities; disputed implementation of a Yemeni security request
record.enforcement: Vehicles and travellers waited at the border; the Yemeni director later recorded admitted SUVs.
record.relationship: Separate renewed vehicle restriction from July 2018 R5-ME-002; no continuous ban between those phases inferred.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no assumption of continuation to the research cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Yemeni authorities described a request to restrict commercial military-use pickups bound for Houthi-controlled territory, and disputed its extension to personal vehicles.
record.context: Travellers and Yemeni officials challenged a wider restriction affecting privately owned SUVs.
record.uncertainty: March onset is approximate: mid-March, about two weeks before April 8, and a 35-day retrospective differ. April 25 proves conditional passage, not removal of every vehicle restriction.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty

Approximate onset and uncertain category exceptions preclude exact duration.
